title: Unity Catalog wikis are in Beta
body: [Unity Catalog wikis](/aws/en/uc-semantics/wikis) are in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). A wiki lets your team document a table's meaning, intended use, and sources, then collaborate on that information. Data owners and stewards draft and publish wikis in Catalog Explorer, manually or with Genie Code, and anyone who can view the table's metadata can comment on, suggest edits to, and react to published wikis. Account admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.
